title: Invite people
summary: The person's personal invites: how many are left, make one with a first message (the invite note, ADR 0136), share it as a link or a QR code, name it, cancel it, and see who joined.

name.description: The name the person gave the invite. Only they see it.

hasLinkHere.description: The link was made on this phone and is kept here. Else bipe_invites_other_device.

note.description: The first message kept on this phone for this invite.

available.description: Invites the person can still make.

nextAvailableAt.description: When the next one comes back, when none is left.

pending.description: Newest first. Expired and revoked go under pending, dimmed.

draftNote.description: The note field when making an invite. Starts as bipe_invite_note_default; the person can edit or clear it.

qrFor.description: The invite whose QR sheet is open.

load.effect: GET /v1/me/invites; keeps links and notes on this phone only for pending invites.

create.effect: POST /v1/me/invites. Keeps the link (bipe.chat/convite/<code>) and the note on this phone, keyed by invite id, and opens the share sheet with bipe_invites_share_message. invite_quota_exhausted shows bipe_invites_none_left with bipe_invites_next.

id.description: A pending invite made on this phone.

share.effect: Opens the system share sheet with bipe_invites_share_message and the link.

id.description: A pending invite made on this phone.

showQr.effect: Opens the QR sheet: the link as a QR code with bipe_invites_qr_footer.

name.description: At most 80 characters; blank removes it.

revoke.effect: DELETE /v1/me/invites/{inviteId}; deletes its link and note here.

chat.effect: Opens the DM with the person who joined (bipe_invites_chat).

sendNotesOnJoin.effect: In the background on foreground and after sync: GET /v1/me/invite-connections and GET /v1/me/invites; for each invite that turned used and still has a note here, sends the note once as a normal encrypted message into the DM with the person who joined, then deletes it, and shows bipe_invites_joined once.

notes: The note never goes to the server; it lives on the phone that made the invite and is sent from there only (ADR 0136). An invite made without a note works the same.
bipe_invite_note_default and bipe_invites_share_message are in the people's voice (pra), on purpose: the person sends them (linguagem.md section 2).
The DM for the note is the invite-pair chat (ADR 0034): reuse an existing DM, else create an encrypted direct room that invites the joined person.
bipe_invites_available and bipe_invites_next take the count and the date formatted by the system; bipe_invites_expires the date.

Bipe logic: BipeInviteCreator.create(note:), createIfAvailable and quota, BipeInviteQuota, BipeInviteStore (links, notes, localNames, seenJoinedInviteIDs) (iOS); BipeInviteCreator, BipeInviteLinkStore.saveNote and takeNote, BipeInviteJoinNotifier, BipeInvitePairs, BipeQrCodeContent (Android).
